benchmark: ASGEND real C memory scan/index performance audit

environment.cache_note: Linux system page cache was not cleared; these are warm/ambient-cache measurements, not cold physical-I/O measurements.

methodology.peak_rss_measurement: sample Linux /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM while scanner child is alive

scenario_setup.new_index: remove .asgend_mem before the timed run; timed scan builds a fresh index
scenario_setup.no_op: untimed initial scan followed by timed unchanged scan
scenario_setup.single_file_change: untimed initial scan, mutate exactly doc_00000, then time scan

methodology.throughput_caveat: logical_mib_per_second = total source-corpus bytes / elapsed time; not measured physical bytes read, especially for no-op scans.
